title: Abuse controls for tenants: acceptable use, takedown, outbound mail and monitor fan-out
description:
Outcome: Paying first removes most sign-up fraud (owner decision 8), but a paying tenant can still publish illegal content, send spam newsletters or point monitors at targets. Needed: an acceptable-use policy in the terms; one operator command that takes a tenant's public site offline (KVS entry to a notice page) without deleting data; per-tenant SES reputation monitoring with automatic pause of sending on complaint rates; monitor targets and rates attributed to the tenant and slowed by PPY-f40a02; abuse reports by email reach the operator. Reader-side abuse stays in PPY-0e5942.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): the edge KVS (takedown entry), amplify/plugins/newsletter (sending pause), monitoring router, terms text (PPY-2f1bb2), docs/operator-alerts.md, a runbook entry (PPY-7438d9).

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-abuse-controls.feature):
Scenario: An operator takes a site offline without deleting it
    Given a confirmed abuse report against "alpha"
    When the operator runs the takedown command
    Then alpha's hosts show the notice page within the TTL, its newsroom is read-only, and its data is intact

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-3bbbf9, PPY-d7274f. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: Behave in staging.
Rollout: Before the first outside tenant (M8).
Risk and mitigation: Risk: takedown used without due process. Mitigation: the command requires a reason and logs it; the tenant is told.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
